summary: The Network Information Center asks participants to make enough copies of any manuals or handbooks they produce so the NIC can distribute them. The NIC planned to send them to Station Agents, to Liaisons, and when useful to outside participants.

eli5.summary: If you write a user guide, please make extra copies. The library will pass them out to everyone who needs one.

questions: what did the nic ask sites to do with handbooks
